title: PeatWatch SQS job message
description: Body of every message on the peatwatch-jobs queue (contracts/queue.md). One message per runs row; produced by the API, consumed by the worker.

contract_version.description: Version of this message contract. Bumped on any breaking change.

kind.description: Same values as the run_kind enum in db-schema.md.

run_id.description: runs.id; the worker updates this row and writes runs/<run_id>/log.jsonl.

windows.description: Resolved date windows, same shape as the API Window schema. pipeline: one to eight windows to composite and classify. change: exactly two, the earlier ('from') first.

params.description: runs.params: the resolved request body (pipeline: windows, model, max_cloud_cover_pct; change: from, to, model).

idempotency_key.description: runs.idempotency_key: SHA-256 of canonical JSON {kind, site, boundary_sha256, params, model} (db-schema.md, runs). Consumers use it to detect redelivery; the claim is the compare-and-set on runs.status.

enqueued_at.description: UTC time the API sent the message (informational).
